Newton Heights

Co. Cork

  • Location

  • Bedrooms

  • Availability

Newton Heights is located at Lotamore in Co. Cork. This new neighbourhood consists of 12 two-bedroom bungalows and 39 three-bedroom houses.

Newton Heights is a short distance from Cork City Centre and less than 5km from the village of Blackpool. Blackpool contains a large shopping centre and retail park that includes a number of supermarkets, pharmacists, and a wide variety of retail outlets. There are several primary and secondary schools within the locality.
